summary: Structured repository documenting progressive C# fundamentals, OOP, and ASP.NET Core Web API development, culminating in production-ready Task Management API with JWT authentication and EF Core.
key_features: Progressive C# & OOP console exercises covering syntax, collections, async/await, and exception handling
ASP.NET Core Web API with middleware pipeline, dependency injection, and attribute routing
Code-first database migrations with EF Core & SQLite
JWT-based authentication with claims and [Authorize] attributes
Swagger/OpenAPI documentation for interactive API testing
DTOs, model validation, and separation of concerns
achievements: Architected secure RESTful API with JWT token generation, claims-based authorization, and EF Core code-first migrations. Overcame middleware configuration, DTO mapping, model validation, and async programming challenges while building production-grade codebase with Swagger documentation and secure endpoint authorization.
